gap_report_metadata.requirement_title: Mobile Device Purchase Journey - Browse, Review, Authenticate, and Continue Purchase

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC3 – Default Product Configuration (Partially Covered) - When the Product Details Page is opened, the application shall: Display the default device colour. Display the default storage option. Display the default payment option. Display the correct pricing for the default configuration. Display the estimated delivery date. Display the promotional offer (if available).
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify default device configuration displays correct values for Colour, Storage, and Payment option on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G details page
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Missing verification of: (1) correct pricing display for default configuration, (2) estimated delivery date display, (3) promotional offer display (if available). Current test case C658 only validates default colour, storage, and payment option visibility.
recommended_test_enhancements: Enhance test case C658 or create new test case to verify: (1) device price is displayed and matches expected value for default configuration (Black, 256GB, 24-month), (2) estimated delivery date is visible and in correct format, (3) promotional offer section is displayed when available or hidden when not applicable.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC4 – Continue Purchase Journey (Partially Covered) - The customer shall be able to: View the Next button. Click the Next button. Continue to the next purchase step. Prevent duplicate submissions when the button is clicked multiple times. Resume the purchase journey after successful authentication.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify Next button behavior when clicked multiple times rapidly to prevent duplicate submissions
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Missing verification of: user can resume the purchase journey after successful authentication. Current test case C664 validates Next button visibility, clickability, duplicate prevention, and continuation to next step, but does not test post-authentication journey resumption.
recommended_test_enhancements: Create new test case to verify: (1) user clicks Next on PDP while unauthenticated, (2) authentication popup appears, (3) user successfully logs in, (4) system automatically redirects user back to the exact purchase step where they were interrupted (PDP with selected configuration preserved), (5) user can continue purchase journey without re-selecting device or configuration.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC5 – Authentication (Partially Covered) - If the customer is not authenticated, the application shall: Display the Login popup after clicking Next. Display Login and Sign Up options. Prevent the purchase journey until authentication is completed. Redirect the customer back to the interrupted purchase step after successful login.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify login or sign-up popup is displayed with correct message and action buttons when unauthenticated user clicks Next
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Missing verification of: customer is redirected back to the interrupted purchase step after successful login. Current test case C660 validates popup display, Login/Sign Up options, and implicit purchase journey prevention, but does not test post-login redirection behavior.
recommended_test_enhancements: Create new test case to verify: (1) unauthenticated user clicks Next on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP with specific configuration (e.g., Blue, 512GB, 12-month), (2) authentication popup appears, (3) user enters valid credentials and logs in successfully, (4) popup closes automatically, (5) user is redirected back to Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP with the same configuration preserved (Blue, 512GB, 12-month), (6) user can immediately click Next again to continue purchase without re-authentication.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC6 – Error Handling (Partially Covered) - The application shall gracefully handle error scenarios including: Network interruption while loading pages. Device unavailability or out-of-stock condition. Slow network response while loading the Product Details Page. HTTP 500/Internal Server Error. API timeout while retrieving product details. Display appropriate error messages without crashing.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify system behavior when user attempts to navigate to All Phones with network interruption
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Missing verification of: (1) device unavailability or out-of-stock condition handling, (2) slow network response while loading PDP, (3) HTTP 500/Internal Server Error handling, (4) API timeout while retrieving product details, (5) comprehensive crash prevention across all error scenarios. Current test case C661 only covers network interruption during All Phones listing page load.
recommended_test_enhancements: Create additional test cases to verify: (1) when Samsung Galaxy A57 5G is out of stock, appropriate message is displayed and user cannot proceed (C662 exists but not mapped to AC6), (2) when PDP loads under slow network (3G), page displays loading indicators and eventually renders correctly without crash (C663 and C673 exist but not mapped to AC6), (3) when API returns HTTP 500 error, user-friendly error message is displayed with retry option, (4) when API times out retrieving product details, timeout error message is displayed without application crash, (5) all error scenarios display appropriate messages and maintain application stability.

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC1 – Mobile Devices Listing (Fully Covered) - The customer shall be able to: Navigate from the StarHub Home page to Mobile → All Phones. View the Mobile Devices listing page. Verify the page heading is displayed correctly. Verify the correct URL is loaded. View all available mobile devices.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can successfully navigate to Mobile Devices listing page from StarHub personal homepage

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC2 – Product Details Page (Fully Covered) - The customer shall be able to: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from the device listing. Navigate to the Product Details Page. Verify the product information. Verify the Product Details Page URL.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device from All Phones listing and navigate to device details page

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC7 – Responsive Authentication Popup (Fully Covered) - The application shall ensure that the authentication popup: Displays correctly on Desktop. Displays correctly on Tablet. Displays correctly on Mobile. Maintains usability across supported screen resolutions.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains functional across different viewport sizes
